verdict.rationale: A probe confirms https://clickhouse.com/llms.txt returns HTTP 200 with structured content describing ClickHouse, directly satisfying the llms.txt story, and this is reinforced by agent-oriented docs/tooling (official MCP server, agent skills repo, CLI) that an agent could also be pointed at. Missing for 10: independent/community confirmation that agents actually consume llms.txt successfully, and no mention of llms.txt in the official docs pages themselves (only the raw endpoint).
